newsitem.title: USA: Talbots sees Q2 loss about $0.28to $0.38/shr.
newsitem.headline: Talbots sees Q2 loss about $0.28to $0.38/shr.

text.p: Talbots Inc said Tuesday it expects a net loss for the second quarter in the range of $0.28 to $0.38 per share, but it expects to remain profitable for the full year.
The company also said it expects positive quarterly sales and earnings comparisons for the third and fourth quarters of the year.
In addition, the company said Clark Hinkley, who had been responsible for merchandising, will relinquish his position as chief operating officer and as a member of the board.
The company said he has accepted the newly created position of executive vice president, manufacturing/special services.
The company has begun a search for a new executive vice president and chief merchandising officer.
The company said it expects its net losses for the second quarter ending August 2 to be in the range of $9 million to $12 million.
The company said the loss is the result of its weak semi-annual sale performance during the last ten days of fiscal June and the anticipated continuation of these sales trends into July.
It also is the result of its practice of providing for all spring markdowns during the second quarter.
Talbots said it believes these "problems" are confined to the first half of the year, and it expects to enter its third fiscal quarter with all new merchandise.
The company said changes in the balance between classic sportswear and casual merchandise in the fall assortments will be presented in stores in early September.
It also said it will launch as planned the most aggressive advertising and marketing program in the its history in early September.
